prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
I can help find the best short‑term rental, but to give a specific listing I need a few details. Meanwhile here are immediate, practical recommendations so you can start searching.

Quick questions
- What are your travel dates (or season)? Availability and price vary a lot.
- Budget per night or total?
- Do you prefer central (Downtown/Gulch) vs quieter residential neighborhoods?
- Will you have a car? Need on‑site parking?
- Kids’ ages (baby/toddler vs older kids)?
- Any must‑have amenities (crib, fenced yard, kitchen, washer/dryer, elevator, pet friendly)?

Best neighborhoods for a family of four
- 12South — walkable, family friendly, boutiques & restaurants, many cute bungalows.
- Germantown — quieter, great restaurants, close to downtown attractions and riverfront parks.
- East Nashville — quirky, local vibe, good for families who want more space and yard.
- Sylvan Park / West End / Hillsboro Village — residential, near Vanderbilt and parks, convenient.
- Green Hills / Belle Meade — suburban, safe, more space; farther from downtown but good if you want calm.

What to book (features to prioritize)
- Entire home/apt with 2+ bedrooms (or a 1BR + sofa bed if kids are small).
- Full kitchen and washer/dryer (makes family life easier).
- On‑site or dedicated parking if you have a car.
- Safe, quiet street or gated property (especially if children).
- Baby gear if needed: crib, high chair, stair gates (filter or ask host).
- Flexible check‑in and good cancellation policy.
- High rating and many recent reviews from families.

Price & timing
- Typical family-friendly rentals in Nashville range widely: roughly $150–$400+/night depending on neighborhood and season.
- Peak times (CMA Fest, major holidays, big concerts) drive prices and sell out fast. Book as early as possible.

How to search effectively
- On Airbnb/VRBO: filter for Entire place, number of bedrooms, amenities (parking, washer, kitchen), Superhost/Top Host, and “family‑friendly” in the description.
- Read at least the last 10 reviews; search reviews for “kids,” “family,” “parking,” and “noise.”
- Confirm exact sleeping arrangements (bed sizes, living room pull‑outs).
- Message hosts to confirm crib/high chair availability and parking details before booking.

Examples of what to look for (phrases to search)
- “Family friendly bungalow 12South”
- “3BR craftsman East Nashville with yard”
- “Germantown townhouse near parks”
- “Downtown/Gulch 2BR condo walk to Broadway” (if you want nightlife access)

If you give me dates, budget, neighborhood preference and kids’ ages I can:
- Pull 4–6 current short‑term rental options that fit your needs (with pros/cons for each), or
- Narrow the search to a single best pick and explain why.

Which would you prefer?
